meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 让 Claude 用 x_search 搜 X(推特):按日期限定时效查询、限定可信账号、拆成 2~3 次搜索,并与网页搜索对照。报告时每条说法附 x.com 原帖链接,并注明那只是某账号的发帖,不是已证实的事实。
howto.when: 当你提到 X 搜索、Twitter 搜索、推文等关键词,或要求看 X 上人们怎么说时触发。前提是已连接 xAI 账号;没连上会直说 x_search 不可用,改用 web_search。

howto.what_en: Claude searches X through the x_search tool: date-bounds time-sensitive queries, limits to trusted handles, splits into 2-3 searches, and reconciles with web_search. Claims get x.com links, labeled as unverified posts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on X search, Twitter search, or tweets, or asking what people are saying on X. Needs a connected xAI account; otherwise it reports x_search unavailable and falls back to web_search.
